name: EPIC 251539285
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 17, 7.9 solar radii and 1.00 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 5,163 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 1.00 solar masses and 7.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,255 K at its surface.
